info.name: KARTSEEK — 20 Hotel Owner Portal APIs
info.description: Hotel owner portal: registration, hotel listing management, dashboard, bookings, pricing (seasonal/bulk), payouts, review management. Super admin panel: stats, hotel approvals, fraud detection, compliance monitoring, revenue analytics, onboarding pipeline.
